title: Text or Image? What is More Important in Cross-Domain Generalization Capabilities of Hate Meme Detection Models?

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Shapley values to evaluate the relative contribution of text versus image features, and comparing the zero-shot cross-domain performance of multimodal models against unimodal text-only classifiers to identify over-reliance on textual elements.

Evaluating model sensitivity and reliance on spurious correlations by creating a confounder dataset where specific controversial figures and celebrities are counterfactually substituted in both text (using Polyjuice) and images.
